name: Disciplinary - SCN
response_html:
Dear Team,

This is to inform you that a disciplinary case of type "{{ case_type }}" has been initiated by HR for the employee {{ employee_name }} (Employee ID: {{ employee_id }}).

Case Details:

  • Case ID: {{ case_id }}
  • Branch: {{ branch_name }}
  • Issue Date: {{ issue_occurrence_date }}
  • Initiated By: {{ hr_name }}

The Show Cause Notice has been generated and forwarded to the respective branch for further action.

Please find the relevant document(s) attached:
{{ document_upload }}

Remarks:
{{ remarks }}

Regards,
HR Department
subject: Show Cause Notice Issued for {{ employee_name }} – Case Type: {{ case_type }}
